groups.name: casehub.qhorus.presence
groups.description: Presence tracking timeouts and heartbeat intervals.

groups.name: casehub.qhorus.tracing
groups.description: OpenTelemetry tracing toggles for qhorus subsystems.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.cleanup.stale-instance-seconds
properties.description: Seconds before an inactive instance is considered stale.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.cleanup.data-retention-days
properties.description: Days to retain transient data before cleanup.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.agent-card.name
properties.description: Display name for the qhorus agent card.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.agent-card.description
properties.description: Description text for the qhorus agent card.
properties.defaultValue: Peer-to-peer agent communication mesh — channels, messages, shared data, presence

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.agent-card.url
properties.description: Optional public URL for the agent card.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.agent-card.version
properties.description: Agent card version string.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.a2a.enabled
properties.description: Enable A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol support.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.a2a.push-to-event-broadcaster
properties.description: Push A2A events to the event broadcaster.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.a2a.sse.heartbeat-interval-seconds
properties.description: SSE heartbeat interval in seconds.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.a2a.sse.max-duration-seconds
properties.description: Maximum SSE connection duration in seconds.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.watchdog.enabled
properties.description: Enable the watchdog evaluation service.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.watchdog.check-interval-seconds
properties.description: Watchdog evaluation interval in seconds.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.attestation.done-confidence
properties.description: Confidence score assigned to DONE attestations.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.attestation.failure-confidence
properties.description: Confidence score assigned to FAILURE attestations.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.attestation.decline-confidence
properties.description: Confidence score assigned to DECLINE attestations.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.attestation.response-confidence
properties.description: Confidence score assigned to RESPONSE attestations.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.attestation.credibility-min-data-points
properties.description: Minimum data points required before credibility scoring applies.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.attestation.credibility-low-agreement-threshold
properties.description: Agreement threshold below which credibility is flagged.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.attestation.collusion-detection-enabled
properties.description: Enable statistical collusion detection across attestors.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.attestation.collusion-threshold
properties.description: Agreement correlation threshold above which collusion is suspected.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.commitment.min-obligor-trust
properties.description: Minimum trust score required for an obligor to accept commitments.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.commitment.default-query-deadline
properties.description: Default deadline for QUERY commitments (e.g. PT30M).

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.commitment.default-propose-deadline
properties.description: Default deadline for PROPOSE commitments (e.g. PT1H).

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.summary.enabled
properties.description: Enable periodic channel summary generation.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.summary.check-interval-seconds
properties.description: Summary check interval in seconds.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.protocol.lookback-size
properties.description: Number of messages to look back for protocol evaluation.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.protocol.request-response.max-open-queries
properties.description: Maximum concurrent open queries per channel for request-response protocol.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.protocol.task-completion.max-open-commands
properties.description: Maximum concurrent open commands per channel for task-completion protocol.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.protocol.contribution-required.max-consecutive
properties.description: Maximum consecutive messages from one participant before contribution is required.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.routing.default-trust-threshold
properties.description: Default trust score threshold for agent routing.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.routing.default-capacity-threshold
properties.description: Optional capacity pressure threshold for routing decisions.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.connector-backend.delivery-channel
properties.description: Optional delivery channel ID for the connector backend.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.delivery.enabled
properties.description: Enable the message delivery pipeline.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.delivery.batch-size
properties.description: Number of messages processed per delivery batch.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.delivery.max-consecutive-failures
properties.description: Maximum consecutive delivery failures before circuit-breaking.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.delivery.reconciliation-interval
properties.description: Delivery reconciliation interval (Duration string, e.g. 30s).

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.delivery.max-participant-retries-per-cycle
properties.description: Maximum participant-level retries per delivery cycle.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.delivery.max-participant-consecutive-failures
properties.description: Maximum consecutive failures before a participant is skipped.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.presence.away-timeout
properties.description: Duration of inactivity before marking a participant as AWAY.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.presence.offline-timeout
properties.description: Duration of inactivity before marking a participant as OFFLINE.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.presence.heartbeat-interval
properties.description: Interval between presence heartbeats.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.tracing.enabled
properties.description: Master toggle for OpenTelemetry tracing in qhorus.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.tracing.dispatch
properties.description: Trace message dispatch operations.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.tracing.commitments
properties.description: Trace commitment lifecycle operations.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.tracing.fan-out
properties.description: Trace message fan-out to channel members.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.tracing.ledger-write
properties.description: Trace ledger write operations.

properties.name: casehub.qhorus.tracing.delivery
properties.description: Trace delivery batch execution.
